name: rpa-gallery
description: Client-side PWA for browsing Ren'Py .rpa archives on a phone

scripts.fixtures: python3 tests/fixtures/gen_fixtures.py tests/fixtures/out && python3 tests/fixtures/gen_phase2.py tests/fixtures/out2
scripts.test:phase1: python3 tests/fixtures/gen_fixtures.py tests/fixtures/out && tsx tests/verify-phase1.ts tests/fixtures/out
scripts.test:phase2: python3 tests/fixtures/gen_phase2.py tests/fixtures/out2 && tsx tests/verify-phase2.mts tests/fixtures/out2
scripts.test: npm run test:phase1 && npm run test:phase2
scripts.test:ui: python3 tests/fixtures/make_media.py .ui-media && python3 tests/fixtures/gen_phase2.py .ui-fixture --media .ui-media && node tests/ui/build-test.mjs .ui-build && node tests/ui/ui-test.mjs .ui-build .ui-fixture .ui-shots
